name: Chenyu Vale
description: The gentle breezes carry the fragrance of tea all across the mountains of Liyue, filling the air with the savory scent once more. "Tea grows upon the rocks, where jade springs endlessly flow." The faint perfume and ancient song of jade drift together along the rivers past Qiaoying Village to the bustling port of Yilong Wharf. Just what adventures and fortune await, concealed among the fog-robed peaks of the south...?
